chunks: You will then be set before Him, and not one of you will remain unexposed.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What happens to hidden deeds on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Haqqah underscores the comprehensive nature of divine knowledge, where not only outward deeds but also the innermost secrets of the heart are laid bare. It serves as a profound reminder of accountability, reinforcing the concept that God's awareness transcends all concealment, a theme often linked with the detailed accounting (Hisab) described in traditions regarding the Day of Reckoning.
